title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In — August 04, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's your boy Ambitriber here with this week's portfolio update. I know some of you have been asking about my top holdings, so I thought I'd give you a quick rundown. I've been holding onto the iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF (IUSQ.DE) for a while now, and I still believe it's a great way to get broad exposure to the global market. It's currently making up 18.82% of my portfolio, and I'm happy to see it performing well.

I've also been keeping an eye on the iShares Edge MSCI USA Value Factor UCITS ETF (QDVI.DE), which is up to 10.12% of my portfolio. I'm a big believer in value investing, and this ETF has been doing a great job of identifying undervalued stocks in the US market. As for Alibaba-ADR (BABA), I've been holding onto it for a while now, and I still think it's a great long-term play. The company has a strong track record of growth, and I'm confident that it will continue to perform well in the future.

As for strategic moves, I'm not planning on making any major changes to my portfolio just yet. I'm happy with my current holdings, and I think they're all performing well. However, I am considering adding some more exposure to the technology sector, as I think it's due for a rebound. We'll see how things play out over the next few weeks.

I want to encourage all of you to stay the course and keep a long-term perspective. It's easy to get caught up in the daily market noise, but it's the long-term trends that really matter. Keep investing, keep learning, and most importantly, keep believing in yourself.
